challenge.name: The Missing Baseline
challenge.description: The KPI definitions were never formally agreed, leaving the project without a clear target for success. #efficiency_emilia# wants the KPI definition to be fully automated and governed to ensure alignment with business goals, while #requirements_reuben# argues it should remain a manual process to allow for careful security and compliance review. #efficiency_emilia# is open to a compromise that keeps the process manual but documented, but #requirements_reuben# insists on strict manual control.
challenge.roundIntroduction: A recent audit revealed that the KPI definitions were lost during a team transition. The team is now scrambling to redefine the success metrics before the next sprint planning session.

on_enter_ops.reason: the previous KPI document was deleted during cleanup

stalemate_ops.reason: without agreed KPIs, acceptance criteria cannot be validated

roster.name: Efficiency Emilia
roster.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.
roster.priorities: Applying deep domain knowledge to ensure models fulfill specific business goals. Aligning ML solutions with clear objectives, KPIs, and business goals. Making organization-level decisions and enhancing overall operational capability. Defining products by defining and optimizing product features.

roster.name: Requirements Reuben
roster.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.
roster.priorities: Guaranteeing high product quality through rigorous testing of applications. Guaranteeing the integrity, confidentiality, and security of all ML assets. Meeting internal and external compliance and data protection standards. Keeping infrastructure stable, reproducible, and cost-controlled.

roster.name: Automation Alex
roster.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.
roster.priorities: Building automated pipelines and maintaining full system operational stability. Ensuring seamless deployment, integration, and stability of models and services in production.

roster.name: Reliability Ruth
roster.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.
roster.priorities: Pushes the delivery of reliable ML-powered features that directly improve the user experience. CI/CD and working feedback loops. Identifying and reporting issues to facilitate iterative improvements.

items.fact: {efficiency_emilia} proposed that the KPI definitions be fully automated and governed to ensure alignment with business goals.

readings.driver: The more the KPI definitions are aligned with business goals, the better the project outcomes will be for the organization.
readings.boundary: She will not accept any KPI definition process that is not fully automated and governed.
readings.trade_off: She would accept a manual process for KPI definitions if it is documented and reviewed by the business team.
readings.fact: That is simply how the KPI definition process is set up in the current project plan.

items.fact: {requirements_reuben} argued that the KPI definitions should remain a manual process to allow for careful security and compliance review.

readings.driver: The more manual the KPI definition process is, the better the security and compliance reviews will be.
readings.boundary: He will not accept any KPI definition process that is automated or governed without his direct manual review.
readings.trade_off: He would accept an automated KPI definition process if it includes a manual security review step.
readings.fact: That is simply how the KPI definition process is set up in the current project plan.

items.fact: {efficiency_emilia} is open to a compromise that keeps the KPI definition process manual but documented.

readings.driver: The more the KPI definitions are documented, the better the alignment with business goals will be.
readings.boundary: She will not accept any KPI definition process that is not documented.
readings.trade_off: She would give up the automation of KPI definitions if the process remains manual but is properly documented.
readings.fact: That is simply how the KPI definition process is set up in the current project plan.

items.fact: {requirements_reuben} noted that the risk assessment must be reviewed manually before acceptance criteria are finalized.

readings.driver: The more the risk assessment is reviewed, the better the acceptance criteria will be for security compliance.
readings.boundary: He will not accept any acceptance criteria that are not manually reviewed against the risk assessment.
readings.trade_off: He would accept automated risk assessment reviews if they are followed by a manual sign-off.
readings.fact: That is simply how the risk assessment and acceptance criteria process works today.

items.fact: {automation_alex} suggested that the data contracts be automated to ensure seamless integration with the ingestion pipeline.

readings.driver: The more the data contracts are automated, the better the integration with the ingestion pipeline will be.
readings.boundary: He will not accept any data contract process that is not automated.
readings.trade_off: He would accept manual data contracts if they are reviewed by the pipeline team.
readings.fact: That is simply how the data contracts and ingestion pipeline are set up in the current project plan.

items.fact: {reliability_ruth} proposed that the acceptance criteria be linked to real-world performance monitoring to ensure reliable ML features.

readings.driver: The more the acceptance criteria are linked to real-world performance, the better the reliability of the ML features will be.
readings.boundary: She will not accept any acceptance criteria that are not linked to real-world performance monitoring.
readings.trade_off: She would accept manual acceptance criteria if they are reviewed by the monitoring team.
readings.fact: That is simply how the acceptance criteria and monitoring are set up in the current project plan.

items.fact: The KPI definitions were lost during a team transition.

readings.driver: The more the KPI definitions are preserved, the better the project outcomes will be.
readings.boundary: The team will not accept any project progress without KPI definitions.
readings.trade_off: The team would accept a delay in the project if KPI definitions are not available.
readings.fact: That is simply the state of the KPI definitions after the team transition.

items.fact: The acceptance criteria are currently done by hand.

readings.driver: The more the acceptance criteria are automated, the better the project outcomes will be.
readings.boundary: The team will not accept any acceptance criteria that are not done by hand.
readings.trade_off: The team would accept automated acceptance criteria if they are reviewed manually.
readings.fact: That is simply how the acceptance criteria process works today.

readings.boundary: The team will not accept any data contracts that are not done by hand.
readings.trade_off: The team would accept automated data contracts if they are reviewed manually.
readings.fact: That is simply how the data contracts process works today.

items.fact: The risk assessment is currently done by hand.

readings.driver: The more the risk assessment is automated, the better the security compliance will be.
readings.boundary: The team will not accept any risk assessment that is not done by hand.
readings.trade_off: The team would accept automated risk assessment if it is reviewed manually.
readings.fact: That is simply how the risk assessment process works today.

items.fact: The link between risk assessment and acceptance criteria is currently done by hand with no trigger.

readings.driver: The more the link between risk assessment and acceptance criteria is automated, the better the security compliance will be.
readings.boundary: The team will not accept any link between risk assessment and acceptance criteria that is not done by hand.
readings.trade_off: The team would accept an automated link between risk assessment and acceptance criteria if it is reviewed manually.
readings.fact: That is simply how the link between risk assessment and acceptance criteria works today.
